description: Independent provider-free held-out acceptance corpus authored from planner and executor contracts. All cases use complete supported_ast gold semantics; meaning_guard records required semantic distinctions, required_atoms are harness-checkable critical nodes, and explanatory_notes justify routing and gold meaning.

cases.question: Does the hidden country have a larger population than Chile?
cases.meaning_guard: Compare target population against Chile population; Chile is not the target identity.
cases.explanatory_notes: The named country supplies the comparison operand while the game target remains the subject.
cases.notes: Named-country population comparison.

cases.question: Czy powierzchnia tego kraju nie przekracza powierzchni Algierii?
cases.meaning_guard: The target area is at most Algeria's area; equality is included and the comparison country is not the target.
cases.explanatory_notes: Nie przekracza denotes an inclusive upper bound; both area operands are explicit.
cases.notes: Polish inclusive area upper bound.

cases.question: Czy kraj leży na wschód od Madagaskaru?
cases.meaning_guard: Use longitude for both target and Madagascar; preserve eastward comparison.
cases.explanatory_notes: Compass east/west comparisons are same-axis longitude relations against a named country.
cases.notes: Same-axis named-reference compass comparison.

cases.question: Czy ten kraj leży na południe od Norwegii?
cases.meaning_guard: Both operands use latitude; do not compare the target with Norway on a different coordinate axis.
cases.explanatory_notes: The Polish south-of relation has an objective same-axis interpretation in the executor.
cases.notes: Polish same-axis compass comparison.

cases.question: Is it north of Greece by longitude?
cases.meaning_guard: Do not turn north into an east/west longitude comparison; ask which spatial relation or axis is intended.
cases.explanatory_notes: North is a latitude relation, while the phrase explicitly specifies longitude, leaving conflicting geography rather than a precise predicate.
cases.notes: Conflicting compass direction and coordinate axis require clarification.

cases.question: Czy wszyscy jego sąsiedzi lądowi należą do UE?
cases.meaning_guard: Universal condition ranges over the target's border-country list, with each bound item tested for EU membership; empty-list all semantics are vacuously true.
cases.explanatory_notes: All is a supported quantifier over list-valued borders_country and its condition uses the bound neighbor item.
cases.notes: Universal neighbor quantifier, including executor vacuity semantics.

cases.question: Czy istnieje sąsiad lądowy, który nie należy do NATO?
cases.meaning_guard: There must be at least one bound land neighbor whose membership list does not contain NATO; this is not the negation of any NATO neighbor.
cases.explanatory_notes: Existential quantification scopes over a negated membership predicate for each item.
cases.notes: Polish existential with inner negation, not global negation.

cases.question: Is it a republic, uses the euro, and has a red flag?
cases.meaning_guard: All three conditions are conjunctive: Republic government category, euro currency, and red flag color.
cases.explanatory_notes: Use the scalar government category and two list relations; the three-clause conjunction is complete.
cases.notes: Three independent local predicates joined by AND.

cases.question: Czy kraj należy do UE lub ma dostęp do oceanu, ale nie używa euro?
cases.meaning_guard: (EU membership OR ocean access) AND NOT euro currency; negation applies only to euro use.
cases.explanatory_notes: The Polish contrastive 'ale nie' preserves the positive disjunction and negates only the final predicate.
cases.notes: Nested OR, conjunction and narrow negation.

cases.question: Does this country belong to the Germanic cultural sphere?
cases.meaning_guard: A cultural-country association is not official-language status, language family, geography, or dominant religion.
cases.explanatory_notes: The cultural association is absent locally; keep the clear question valid and send it to fallback.
cases.notes: Unsupported cultural association without a proxy relation.

cases.question: Is its population at most 750,000?
cases.meaning_guard: Population <= 750,000, including equality.
cases.explanatory_notes: At most is an inclusive numeric upper boundary supported by the population metric.
cases.notes: Inclusive population upper bound.

cases.question: Would Christianity be described as its predominant religion?
cases.meaning_guard: Ordinary Christianity is the umbrella OR of Catholic, Orthodox, Protestant and Christianity.
cases.explanatory_notes: The umbrella spans denominational categories; standalone Christianity equality misses Christian countries.
cases.notes: Ordinary broad Christianity umbrella.

cases.question: Czy dominującą kategorią religijną jest prawosławie?
cases.meaning_guard: Map Polish prawosławie to the supported Orthodox category, not Christianity generally.
cases.explanatory_notes: Orthodox is an explicit available religion category, and Polish wording translates unambiguously.
cases.notes: Polish explicit Orthodox category.

cases.question: Is Lutheranism the country's dominant Christian denomination?
cases.meaning_guard: Do not answer a finer denomination by substituting broad Protestant, Christianity, or another stored dominant category.
cases.explanatory_notes: Local religion values distinguish broad Protestant and Christianity but not Lutheran denomination; this clear criterion needs external facts.
cases.notes: Precise unsupported denominational classification routes to fallback.

cases.question: Is this country larger than the average country?
cases.meaning_guard: No average reference or definition of the comparison set is given; do not invent a world mean or ranking.
cases.explanatory_notes: Larger lacks a specified objective comparator; knowing area does not define which average is meant.
cases.notes: Vague comparative size with unspecified comparison criterion.

cases.question: Czy angielska nazwa kraju zawiera dokładny fragment "land"?
cases.meaning_guard: Test exact quoted substring 'land' in the English common country name; do not translate or replace its characters.
cases.explanatory_notes: The target's name is text and contains_text performs substring matching; the quoted foreign-language prompt still refers to the English name.
cases.notes: Quoted substring is retained literally in a Polish question.

cases.question: Czy to Stany Zjednoczone?
cases.meaning_guard: Identity check uses the common English country name United States, not its official long name.
cases.explanatory_notes: Direct identity is a valid supported yes/no question and Polish country name translates unambiguously.
cases.notes: Common-name identity question.

cases.question: Does its official constitutional name contain the words 'Kingdom of'?
cases.meaning_guard: The requested official constitutional-name text is not the supported common name field; do not test target_country.name as a substitute.
cases.explanatory_notes: The planner requires external facts for official long names when they differ from the locally supported common-name relation.
cases.notes: Official-name wording calls for unsupported text, not common-name substring.

cases.question: Czy mieszkańcy zwykle mówią po portugalsku?
cases.meaning_guard: This asks about what residents usually speak, not legal official-language status.
cases.explanatory_notes: Language prevalence is not established by official_language; use external knowledge rather than substituting co-official status.
cases.notes: Polish language-use frequency routes to fallback.

cases.question: Is the country's main national language of Turkic origin?
cases.meaning_guard: Preserve the principal-language usage and language-origin criteria; do not reduce this to whether a Turkic language is official.
cases.explanatory_notes: Main-language prevalence and language-family origin are general-knowledge facts absent from supported relations.
cases.notes: Culture/language prevalence and origin require fallback.

cases.question: Czy powierzchnia tego kraju jest mniejsza niż 120 000 km²?
cases.meaning_guard: Strict area < 120,000 km²; equality is excluded.
cases.explanatory_notes: Mniejsza niż means strictly less than; the provided threshold is unambiguous.
cases.notes: Polish strict area upper boundary.

cases.question: Czy kraj ma dostęp do morza, jeździ się w nim lewą stroną i jego walutą jest jen?
cases.meaning_guard: All three predicates are required: sea access, left-side traffic, and yen as currency.
cases.explanatory_notes: The three facts use the documented water access, driving side and currency relations.
cases.notes: Polish three-condition conjunction.

cases.question: Was the country in the USSR or in Yugoslavia?
cases.meaning_guard: Historical membership in either of two named supported dissolved unions suffices.
cases.explanatory_notes: Historical_union explicitly stores both named polities; this is OR, not present membership.
cases.notes: Two-branch historical-union disjunction.

cases.question: Are all of its bordering countries republics?
cases.meaning_guard: Every bound border-country item must have government_type Republic; executor all returns true on an empty list.
cases.explanatory_notes: The list and scalar item property are both supported; universal quantification intentionally keeps its documented empty-list behavior.
cases.notes: Universal borders quantification with explicit vacuous scope.

cases.question: Czy żaden z sąsiadów lądowych nie używa euro?
cases.meaning_guard: No neighbor is an EU/euro predicate substitute; specifically, negate the existence of any land neighbor using EUR.
cases.explanatory_notes: Polish żaden ... nie means not(any neighbor whose currency list contains EUR), not an unscoped currency negation.
cases.notes: Negated existential; false on any euro-using neighbor.

cases.question: Is Catholicism the dominant religion category there?
cases.meaning_guard: Use the explicit Catholic category, not the broader Christianity umbrella.
cases.explanatory_notes: Catholic is a supported dominant religion grouping with scalar equality semantics.
cases.notes: English explicit Catholic denomination category.

cases.question: Czy ten kraj znajduje się blisko Maroka?
cases.meaning_guard: Nearness has no distance threshold; do not substitute a shared border or point-coordinate comparison.
cases.explanatory_notes: The named reference is clear but 'blisko' lacks an objective proximity criterion, so clarification precedes local-coverage routing.
cases.notes: Polish vague proximity with named reference.

cases.question: Does the common English country name end with the letters 'ia'?
cases.meaning_guard: Test the two quoted letters at the end of the common English name, not an official long name or a country-language fact.
cases.explanatory_notes: The common name is a supported scalar text relation and ends_with preserves the requested suffix exactly.
cases.notes: Supported English common-name suffix.

cases.question: Is the country north of Senegal, an African Union member, and not an island country?
cases.meaning_guard: AND all three: target latitude is north of Senegal's latitude, target is an AU member, and is_island is false.
cases.explanatory_notes: The question has an objective same-axis point comparison plus two supported target facts; no clause is dropped.
cases.notes: Three-clause mix with compass reference and negated boolean property.

cases.question: Czy kraj ma powierzchnię co najmniej 9 000 000 km²?
cases.meaning_guard: Target area >= 9,000,000 km²; equality counts.
cases.explanatory_notes: Co najmniej means an inclusive lower bound on the directly supported area metric.
cases.notes: Polish inclusive area lower bound.
